title: JSW Energy Ltd - 533148 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: JSW Energy Q4 FY26 revenue rose 39% YoY to ₹4,851 crore and EBITDA 72% to ₹2,602 crore; FY26 EBITDA hit a record ₹11,041 crore.
summary.overview: Installed capacity rose 2.6 GW in FY26 to 13.45 GW, with generation up 58% YoY, and Q4 net generation rose 48% YoY to 11.7 BU. Q4 PAT was ₹574 crore (up 38%) while PAT to shareholders was ₹308 crore, with depreciation up ~1.7x and interest up ~2.4x YoY as new assets capitalised. Management guided FY27 to be a year of accelerating earnings, with ~3 GW of RE additions and ~₹20,000 crore capex, and kept net debt/EBITDA at ~5.2x (ex-CWIP debt). Merchant realisations were ~20% above exchange prices in FY26, though exchange prices averaged ~₹3.86/unit.

financial_highlights.metric: Q4 merchant EBITDA at KSK Mahanadi

segments.name: Renewables
segments.commentary: Q4 renewable generation rose 68% YoY on wind, solar, hydro and O2 Power additions; 118 MW organic RE added in Q4. Installed base is 13.45 GW after 2.6 GW added in FY26 (1.3 GW acquired, rest organic).

segments.name: Thermal
segments.commentary: Q4 thermal generation rose 43% YoY to 8.8 BU; portfolio PLF 78% in Q4 and 73% in FY26 versus national averages of 68.7% and 65.8%. KSK Mahanadi Q4 PLF 93%, FY26 KSK EBITDA above ₹3,300 crore; Utkal Q4 PLF 75%, Vijayanagar Q4 PLF 79%.

segments.name: Energy storage
segments.commentary: 5 GWh battery assembly facility in Pune commissioned in Q4 FY26 with commercial sales started; locked-in storage is 29.6 GWh (3.2 GWh BESS, 26.4 GWh pumped hydro).

guidance_outlook: FY27: ~3 GW of capacity additions (about 35-40% wind, rest solar/hybrid), split roughly evenly between H1 and H2; FY27 capex about ₹20,000 crore, of which ~₹4,000-5,000 crore for thermal and pumped storage.
FY28 RE additions guided at ~3-3.5 GW; thermal (KSK 1.8 GW) and partial Salboni capacity add to FY29-FY30.
KSK first 600 MW thermal unit expected by mid-FY28; Tidong 150 MW hydro: 50 MW commissioned 8 May 2026, balance two units before June 2026.
Curtailment expected to end by July 2026 when the Rajasthan evacuation line is commissioned.
Steady-state EBITDA for KSK base case ₹2,700 crore; management expects to beat it. Steady-state EBITDA for ~6 GW wind and solar about ₹75 lakh per MW per year.
New DSM regulations budgeted at 1.5-2% revenue impact on renewables without substation grouping.
Net debt/EBITDA target about 5-5.5x by 2030; FY30 targets of 30 GW generation and 40 GWh storage; locked-in capacity 32.1 GW.
Effective tax rate expected to move toward 23-24% as deferred tax benefits and MAT credit adjustments run through.
capex_capacity: Under construction: ~14 GW, all under long-term PPAs; CWIP ₹17,300 crore at FY26 end, of which ~₹11,200 crore RE.
Salboni thermal now 3,200 MW (two 1,600 MW PPAs); first 1,600 MW under construction with equipment procurement on schedule. GE Power boiler business acquisition expected to close within two quarters.
Pumped storage: Stage 1 forest clearance received; 36-month construction timeline; electro-mechanical ordering placed.
Blade manufacturing plant at Halol expected to commission in H1 FY27; Sany wind turbine contract for 2.4 GW fixed in price and currency with supplies started.
Pipeline of ~4.6 GW with Letters of Intent secured beyond the 14 GW under construction.
demand_pricing: Power demand grew 0.9% in FY26 (weakest in five years) and 2.2% in Q4; FY27 YTD demand up 4.6%. Peak demand 256 GW on 25 April 2026; system preparing for ~270 GW.

Merchant exchange prices averaged ~₹3.86/unit in FY26; JSW realised 20%+ premium through back-to-back short-term contracts, and management says it will keep at least a 20% premium on merchant tariffs.
Utkal 400 MW 25-year PPA at ₹5.78/unit; 115 MW 2-year PPA with Assam discom from 1 April 2026. Open capacity now about 5% of installed base.
No new PPA signings expected for unsigned national capacity until evacuation eases, which management sees as 2029.

qa_highlights.question: Breakdown of FY27 RE additions and FY28 guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: About 3 GW in FY27, 35-40% wind and rest solar/hybrid; FY28 about 3-3.5 GW, with thermal and pumped storage adding from FY29-30.

qa_highlights.question: Is the KSK minority buyout amount crystallised, and what is the KSK PPA outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Not yet crystallised; number expected by end of Q2. KSK's last unit may be merchant for now, but the company prefers long-term PPAs and is talking to states.

qa_highlights.question: Is the ₹20,000 crore capex fundable from internal cash flows, and what is the CWIP breakup?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said internal cash flows and leverage limits can fund it; ₹1,800 crore warrants available as backup. Thermal and pumped storage get ₹4,000-5,000 crore.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Mytrah EBITDA jump YoY?
qa_highlights.answer: One-off of about ₹210 crore from a Supreme Court order on generation-based incentive at 50 paise/unit, including past recoveries; recurring going forward.

qa_highlights.question: What are the DSM impact assumptions?
qa_highlights.answer: Budgeted impact 1.5-2% of revenue without substation grouping; grouping would reduce it. Industry representations are pending.

qa_highlights.question: What was the curtailment impact?
qa_highlights.answer: About ₹16 crore in Q4 and ~₹50 crore in FY26, from temporary-access assets in Rajasthan; the rest is under permanent recovery and paid.

qa_highlights.question: What was KSK merchant EBITDA in Q4?
qa_highlights.answer: ₹203 crore from merchant sales in the quarter, disclosed in closing remarks.

risks_watch: Evacuation and connectivity: national evacuation build-out was about 9,500 circuit km against ~15,000 planned; management has deliberately delayed some projects until connectivity is ready, so FY27 3 GW depends on timing.
DSM regulation change: 1.5-2% revenue hit budgeted for renewables, with a possible further increase later.
Cost pressure from solar cells, steel and BESS pack prices; wind largely insulated by fixed-price Sany contract for 1.5-2 years.
KSK minority buyout (26%) amount and timing not yet crystallised; expected by end Q2.
Holdco debt about ₹15,000 crore at ~8.2%, with ~₹4,500 crore short-term; refinancing at operating-company level needed.
KSK tariff step-down at UPPCL from FY27 partly offset by cost savings; base-case steady-state EBITDA ₹2,700 crore.
Deferred tax asset recognition inflated Q4 PAT; ETR to move to 23-24%.
summary.management_tone: Confident on execution and FY27 delivery, and direct on the DSM and curtailment impact. Management was evasive on the KSK buyout amount, the BESS order book and pricing, and the merchant revenue split, deferring those to later updates.
key_quotes: FY2026 has been defined by scale and integration.
every investment must meet our mid-teen return thresholds, and our balance sheet management continues to be guided by our leverage guardrails.

So, we don't see any challenges and with large significant portion of our capacity at advanced stage of commissioning, we are confident at this time that definitely 3 GW of capacity addition will happen without any challenge.
